summary: PR #84: bind approved requirement-design files to the exact managed release source root rather than a stale shared checkout; preserve fail-closed Goal completion and evidence semantics.

components.owning_subsystem: LFL Goal requirement coverage and TaskStore completion gate
components.disposition: Reuse existing read-only design-path resolver and managed_service_deployment.json identity. Only a validated pinned release code_root may supply approved design bytes; malformed/missing identity, SHA mismatch, symlink or path traversal must fail closed. No new writable authority or Goal state is introduced.
components.verification_level: Six focused managed-release path tests and predecessor independent Reviewer PASS plus original complete R9 exit 0 at 04802f64; the manifest-only successor must receive fresh exact-tree Reviewer, complete R9, A.5, privacy scan and required remote CI.
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: Independent Reviewer and Host admission must veto any SHA/content drift or incomplete evidence; the approved requirements scope remains mandatory and cannot be silently cancelled or auto-accepted.
components.rollback_route: Revert PR #84 through protected GitHub after independent review; keep existing TaskStore, Goal evidence, and deployed service unchanged until separately authorized and verified.

g1.necessity: A shared main checkout may lag the managed service release, causing an approved requirements_scope design file to appear missing and blocking valid Goal evidence binding.

g2.authority_owner: Existing Goal/TaskStore and approved design scope remain the source of truth; service-control managed deployment identity selects only the read-only release code_root.
g2.non_duplication: No parallel Goal/Task/evidence database, new signer, or fallback to an untrusted workspace path; only existing release identity and coverage validation are reused.

model_evidence: tests/unit/test_goal_requirement_scope_gate.py covers pinned release resolution, root decoy rejection, stale/cross-workspace pointers, symlink escape, missing/corrupt identity, and symlinked manifest.
The previous exact code tree 989c255e passed independent review and original full R9; a new manifest changes the tree and must be revalidated before merge.
g3.recovery_or_reason: On invalid managed identity, path escape, or missing approved design, reject coverage binding without completing the Goal; repair the managed release/scope evidence and rerun verification.

g4.rollback: Protected revert of PR #84 restores the previous resolver; keep all TaskStore/Goal records and existing deployment untouched until the successor is verified.
